result: Revised `docs/feature/02-design.md` (583 lines) for the five round-three issues: made workflow versions immutable (`team_workflow_versions` + live `team_workflows` pointer) so edits never rewrite frozen rules; fixed `rebase_work_item` to **require** a `status_map` entry for the item's current status (→ `rebase_conflict` otherwise, closing the R4 hole) while keeping read-only archived columns only for pre-rebase board rendering; hardened sign-off against races (revalidate `from_status` + `FOR UPDATE` on completion, auto-`superseded` pending requests on any real move/rebase, partial unique index `work_item_signoff_requests(work_item_id) WHERE status='pending'`, `superseded` added to the CHECK, one approval per identity via PK); corrected grants (`work_item_signoff_requests` UPDATE, `team_workflows` UPDATE, `team_workflow_event_log` INSERT) and the garbled event-log sentence; fixed `mindmap_workflow_update` `orphaned_statuses` semantics (only meaningful with `reject_if_orphans=false`) and E8 "terminal per the frozen workflow"; and naming (approvals key `approver_identity_id` with a tenant==identity note citing `auth/rbac.py:28`; `'__entry__'` sentinel instead of "sentinel-free"; "MCP" not "MCMC"; named all three team-creation hook sites for `ensure_default_workflow`).
